name: davnai
description: Davnai turns one video into finished edits, Shorts and social posts in your voice, and schedules them for your approval.

interface.longDescription:
Davnai is a content engine for creators and small teams. Record or upload one video and Davnai helps you turn it into everything you need to share it.

From ChatGPT you can:
- See your videos, pictures, scripts and finished edits in Davnai.
- Ask the AI Director to plan an edit of a video, then review and approve the plan.
- Find the best moments for Shorts and make them.
- Write posts, titles and descriptions in your own voice for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook and more.
- Add posts to your social calendar, move them, or cancel them.
- Check how your posts are doing and read comments.
- Make pictures and thumbnails that follow your Brand Kit.

Nothing is ever published from ChatGPT without your approval: posts wait in Davnai until you approve them. Everything follows your Davnai plan, and you choose what ChatGPT may do (read, create, or publish) when you connect.
defaultPrompt: Write LinkedIn and Instagram posts from my latest Davnai video
What's on my Davnai social calendar this week?
Find the best Shorts moments in my newest video

positive.description: Lists the person's videos in Davnai
positive.prompt: What videos do I have in Davnai?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the test account's videos with their names and dates. No changes are made.

positive.description: Writes social posts from a video in the person's voice
positive.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post and an Instagram caption from my most recent Davnai video.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest video, then returns a draft LinkedIn post and Instagram caption based on its transcript. Nothing is scheduled or published.

positive.prompt: What's on my Davnai social calendar for the next 7 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists scheduled and waiting posts for the next week with platform, day and time, or says the calendar is empty.

positive.description: Finds moments for Shorts in a video
positive.prompt: Find the best moments for Shorts in my newest Davnai video.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns suggested moments with start and end times and a short reason for each. If none have been found yet, starts finding them and says when to check back.

positive.prompt: How much of my Davnai plan have I used this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the plan name and what has been used and what is left this month. No dollar amounts are shown.

negative.description: Unrelated request: Davnai should not be used. ChatGPT should answer on its own without calling any Davnai tool.
negative.prompt: What's a good recipe for banana bread?

negative.description: Publishing without approval: Davnai never publishes directly from ChatGPT. At most it adds posts to the calendar as waiting for approval and explains that the person approves them in Davnai.
negative.prompt: Post this to my Instagram right now without asking me: 'Big news coming Friday!'

negative.description: Another person's data: Davnai only acts for the signed-in person and has no way to read other accounts. It should say it can only see the signed-in person's own content.
negative.prompt: Show me the videos and posts of other Davnai users.

review.commerce_description: Davnai does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. Plans are bought on davnai.com.

publication.release_notes: First release of Davnai for ChatGPT: see your videos, plan edits with the AI Director, find Shorts, write posts in your voice, manage your social calendar and check results. Nothing is published without your approval in Davnai.
